IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on State Government.

Bill.BriefDescription: Designating hops as the state flowering vine.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a state flowering vine; and adding a new sectionto chapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The common hop, Humulus lupulus, is designated as the officialflowering vine of the state of Washington.
